5 Telling the time

Two common ways are possible: 12.25 = twenty-five past twelve / twelve twenty-five; 11.45 = quarter to twelve / eleven forty-five.

Tap a time phrase, then tap the matching clock. The phrase bank stays visible while you work.
Self-work

6 Personal time questions

The original group discussion has been reformulated for one learner. Answer each question aloud first. Type notes only if they help you.

1. What time is it now?
2. What time did this study session start?
3. What time do you plan to finish?
4. What time do you usually get up?
5. What time did you go to bed last night?
6. What time do you usually catch a bus or train in the morning?
7. What time do you usually get home?
8. What time do you usually have dinner?
